source.publication: 2025 Kentucky Form 740 packet with instructions (Kentucky Department of Revenue), with 2025 Form 740, Schedule M, Schedule P and Schedule ITC
source.section: Form 740 (2025) page 1 lines 5-19 and page 2 lines 20-22 (740_2025.pdf PDF pp.1-2); packet PDF p.13 Line 5, Lines 6-9 (Kentucky AGI), Line 10 'Nonitemizers, enter the standard deduction of $3,270 ... If filing a joint return, only one $3,270 standard deduction is allowed', Line 11, Line 12 'Multiply line 11 by four percent (.04)'; packet PDF p.3 'For 2025, the standard deduction is $3,270' and 'the tax rate for individual income tax is 4%'; Schedule M (2025) PDF p.1 line 9 and PDF p.3 Line 9 Pension Income Exclusion ('100 percent of taxable retirement benefits or $31,110, whichever is less ... for each taxpayer and must be computed independently of your spouse') and Pension Income Exclusion Worksheet Steps 1-3; Schedule P (2025) PDF p.1 flowchart and lines 1-4, PDF p.2 Types of Income Subject to Exclusion; packet PDF p.9 chart item 4; Schedule P (2025) PDF p.1 Part I line 1 (supplemental (Tier 2) U.S. Railroad Retirement Board benefits) and flowchart ('completely excludable above the $31,110'), PDF p.2 Part I; packet PDF p.9 chart item 5; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section B line 1 (taxpayer) and line 5 (spouse) 'If you were 65 on or before 12/31/2025, enter 40'; Form 740 lines 16-18 (line 18: if line 17 is larger than line 16, enter zero); packet PDF p.14 Line 17; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section C Family Size Tax Credit Table (family size one: not over 15,650 100% ... over 20,815 0; family size two: not over 21,150 100% ... over 28,130 0); packet PDF p.26 Worksheet for Computation of Modified Gross Income lines (a)-(j) and Section C family size definitions; packet PDF p.11 Modified Gross Income; packet PDF p.14 Line 20 and Line 21 (MGI 42,760 or less); Form 740 page 2 lines 20-22 (line 21: line 19 times the decimal from Schedule ITC)

worked: Single, 68: supplemental (Tier 2) railroad retirement 20,000 (Form 1040 line 5(b)) and an IRA distribution 40,000. Tier 2 benefits are wholly excluded on Schedule P Part I, on top of the 31,110 limit on the IRA. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = Tier 2 railroad retirement (person 0) 20,000.00 + IRA distribution (person 0) 40,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 42,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 740, Filing Status 1 (single). Line 5 federal AGI 60,000.00. Line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 = 60,000.00. Person 0 (Column B) Schedule P: line 1 Tier 2 railroad benefits 20,000.00 (no service-credit test and no limit), line 1(c) 20,000.00; line 2 other taxable retirement income 40,000.00; line 3 lesser of line 2 or 31,110 = 31,110.00; line 4 = 20,000.00 + 31,110.00 = 51,110.00. Schedule M line 9 excludable retirement income = 51,110.00. Schedule M line 17 total subtractions 51,110.00; Form 740 line 8 51,110.00. Line 9 Kentucky AGI = 60,000.00 - 51,110.00 = 8,890.00. Line 10 standard deduction 3,270.00; line 11 taxable income = 8,890.00 - 3,270.00 = 5,620.00. Line 12 tax = 5,620.00 x 0.04 = 224.80; lines 13 and 15 0.00; line 14 and line 16 224.80. Schedule ITC Section B: person 0 (age 68) 40; under-65 persons 0; line 17 = 40.00; line 18 = 224.80 - 40.00 = 184.80. Line 19 = 184.80. Modified gross income worksheet: (a) 60,000.00; (c) non-Kentucky municipal interest 0.00; (e) 60,000.00; (f) Kentucky AGI 8,890.00; (i) 8,890.00; (j) greater = 60,000.00. MGI 60,000.00 is over 42,760: no Family Size Tax Credit; line 21 0.00. Line 22 = 184.80 - 0.00 = 184.80. Credits = 40.00 + 0.00 = 40.00; state income tax 184.80. The form enters whole dollars; expected keeps the formula result to the cent.
